verdict: Ads are running, but leads are not reaching your pipeline — fixing that now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Google Ads recorded 16 conversions on $1,687.76 in spend, yet zero leads are showing up in your CRM — the ads are working, but something between the ad click and your intake system is severed. At the same time, Google Business Profile engagement dropped 61% this past week, with actions falling to zero over the last three days of the period, pointing to a short-term dip in local visibility that we're watching closely. The most likely cause of the intake gap is a routing issue: with the dispatch seat vacant since early July, lead notifications have likely been arriving with no one to receive them, and 84 contacts and 49 open opportunities are sitting in your pipeline without a single appointment booked. We're resolving the routing so incoming contacts reach an active owner, and the intake owner confirmation is targeted for August 31 — once that's in place, the pipeline can move. Heading into September, heating season campaigns are queued to switch on, and several site and content improvements are scheduled to support that push.
